summary: Frontend retest of the iteration_31 mobile issues at 390x844, plus desktop regression check at 1920. Logged in as admin admin@example.invalid. Overflow sweep on 16 main pages (/, ventes, rapport, progression, heures-sup, chantiers, planning, clients, carte, commissions, prospecteur, stock, utilisateurs, journal, parametres, abonnement): every page has scrollWidth 390 and no element sticks out past the viewport. All 9 retest items pass. (1) EditSaleSheet footer: Supprimer is full width, with Annuler and Enregistrer above it; Enregistrer is fully visible (x=118 to 223). (2) NewSaleSheet and EditSaleSheet are 390px wide on mobile (inner scrollWidth equals clientWidth, 389), and the date inputs are not clipped. (3) /parametres: settings-save-btn at x=169, no overflow. (4) /rapport: no overflow, report-next visible. (5) /commissions: buttons wrap, no overflow. (6) /planning: cal-prev, the month label and cal-next share one row (y=258), and the filter is full width. (7) /prospecteur has 16px padding. (8) main has 96px bottom padding (pb-24). (9) Heures sup sticky cells have opaque backgrounds (white or slate-50). The payment select lists 'RAC' as the last option, not 'RAC (Reste à charge)'. Stock shows mobile cards (no table visible). ProjectDialog date and duration fields stack full width (340px). Desktop 1920: no overflow on Ventes, Planning, Parametres, Rapport and Commissions; NewSale and EditSale sheets are 576px wide (max-w-xl).

issues: LOW: the controls row wraps. report-prev and the 'Octobre 2026' label sit on one line and report-next drops alone to the next line (x=16), so the < and > buttons are split. Suggest grouping prev/label/next in their own non-wrapping flex (like CalendarPage) and letting only Export PDF wrap above.
COSMETIC: Annuler and Enregistrer are auto-width and left-aligned while Supprimer is full width. Consider 'w-full sm:w-auto' on the inner div with flex-1 buttons.
INFO: the 3-column Seuil/Taux row does not stack, but each column is 97px and '30000' and the % values fit, so it is acceptable.
